entries.017ac3d9e165108c: This business manufactures and sells forging machinery, industrial machinery, steel structures and environmental recycling equipment. Protective equipment for the security field and equipment for the energy field are also growing. The business is centered on the subsidiary Mitsubishi Nagasaki Machinery Works. entries.3fb2bd340f4c9255: Cast Steel and Forged Steel Products
entries.405933236b3a1b85: This business manufactures and sells specialty steel products such as carbon steel, low-alloy steel, spring steel and bearing steel.
